platform: Apple M4 16 GiB, macOS arm64, AppleClang 21 Release -O3, OpenBLAS 0.3.32
dataset: SIFT base 1M x 128 + SIFT learn prefix
timing_scope: memory-resident construction core; not complete HGraph ImportCache/Build
